source.constants: fitted to JPL DE200/LE200; the corrections of the notice, sect. 7, are applied to the main problem as elp82b.f does
source.frame: geocentric; longitude and latitude on the inertial mean ecliptic of date from the departure point gamma'2000, then Laskar's P, Q to the inertial mean ecliptic and equinox of J2000 (notice sect. 8)

truncation.rule: keep a term when its peak contribution over the coverage window, |A| * t_abs**p, reaches the threshold of its coordinate (A after the DE200/LE200 corrections for the main problem; p = 1 for the /t files, 2 for ELP34-36, else 0; t in Julian centuries of TDB from J2000)
